column1: # Shape classes held OUT of the emitted training vectors, and why.
# A quarantined statement STAYS in corpus/analytics-hits.sql — it is still
# linted, still documented, still reproducible. It is only excluded from the
# text a profile run executes, and gen-corpus.sh prints a loud line naming
# every exclusion so it cannot become invisible. Empty file = nothing excluded.
# Quarantine is for statements the ENGINE cannot currently survive, never for
# statements that are inconvenient. Each line must name a defect to close.
